notes.title: Everybody’s GOLF Hot Shots Update Details - 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Everybody’s GOLF Hot Shots. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update released on September 12th, 2025.

▼Update Details■ Bug Fixes
Fixed and adjusted issues such as progression stopping in Online GOLF.

Adjusted the "Group Match" mode to display the time limit when other players are operating.

Fixed progression stopping issues in World Tour.

Fixed progression stopping and other issues related to gameplay.

Fixed an issue where the game would become unable to progress if "Shot Start Camera" in "Game Settings" was set to "5" and certain conditions were met.

Fixed an issue where holing out under certain conditions would result in an OB (out of bounds) penalty.

Fixed an issue where the game would become unplayable near shrubs and grass.

Fixed issues with VTR.

Fixed a problem where club set data was not being saved. (Past data will not be played back correctly if you play VTR using club sets other than Normal.)

Other: Fixed several other issues.

notes.title: A golf game for everyone is smashing its way across the fairway! 🏌️⛳
notes.content:
Tee up with friends, solo challenging tournaments, or take a swing at other zany modes when EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS arrives later this year!

Let's par-TEE! 

[previewyoutube=HHTL6oQfW2k;full][/previewyoutube]

⛳ The Classic Gameplay Everybody Loves

The three-button shot mechanic lets anybody jump in and begin playing - just aim, time the three button presses, and hit the perfect shot! It's easy to learn yet challenging to master.

⛳ Play Solo or With Friends

Play solo and climb the ranks in Challenge Mode or sharpen your skills to beat your personal record in Solo Rounds.
You can also enjoy local Multiplayer Mode with up to 4 players on a single controller or compete online against golfers worldwide, with more modes to discover!

⛳ A New Tee-rific Game Mode

For even more excitement, try Wacky Golf - a unique twist on golf that everybody can enjoy together.
